pure-announcement.rationale: It is launch coverage, but the meta-harness abstraction — harnesses share a uniform messages-in/streams-out interface, so a layer above can make them swappable and enforce stateful policies there instead of in prompts — is an idea that transfers beyond Omnigent.

duplicate.rationale: No nearest concept covers a composition-and-governance layer above agent harnesses; proxy-boundary-session-capture shares only the egress-proxy locus, used here for secret injection rather than capture.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The project is public on GitHub with docs, so the architectural claims are checkable against the code.

durability.rationale: The note leans on the current state of an alpha project — the specific harness roster, install commands, credential types, unshipped roadmap items — which will churn even if the meta-harness idea persists.

actionability.rationale: Its concrete steps are all Omnigent-specific (curl install, omni setup, product YAML), while the transferable patterns like harness-layer budget policies and egress-proxy secret injection are described only as features.

atomicity.rationale: Composition, control, and collaboration are all facets of the single statable idea of a governance layer that treats agent harnesses as interchangeable components.
